source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives reverse-KL fast-rate analysis under single-policy function-class concentrability, a density-ratio lower bound, and explicitly states the relevant single-policy coverage quantities are not comparable up to constants.
The paper studies KL-regularized offline multi-armed bandits, gives matching fast and slow regimes, and explicitly names extension to linear or general function approximation as future work.
The paper gives pessimistic learners for offline linear contextual bandits using covariance-based ell_p confidence sets and documents the rotation ambiguity of PUNC's ell_1 complexity.
The paper develops interactive-Fano and fractional-covering lower-bound methodology for statistical estimation and interactive decision making.
The paper studies passive and active contextual linear best-policy identification and derives information-theoretic sample lower bounds governed by contextual-linear information geometry.
